INTERACTIVE ART STUDY · NOT A FINISHED GAME

THE EXPERIENCE

The world is the interface.

You discover places, notice absences and decide where to put your attention. The environment carries the tension before anyone speaks.

WHAT IT WOULD TAKE

A strong environment, deliberate camera work and a few convincing characters. The most demanding route for art production.
